introduction.title: Cards in order
introduction.explanation: The robot does your cards in order, one at a time, top to bottom.

realWords.text: Each card is one line of code. Programmers call a line that does one thing a statement. In TypeScript a statement ends with a semicolon, like the full stop at the end of a sentence.
This line calls forward: it tells the robot to do it now. The dot means forward belongs to the robot, and the round brackets mean go.
Your cards go between the curly brackets of main. A program has to start somewhere, and programmers often name that place main.
The robot was written by someone else and kept in a library called wonderbits. import brings it into your program so you can use it. Real programs import other people's code all the time.
